book.name: Matai
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Matai byex o

content: Yesu me Yoan Lipekeing
Ka Yesu neil qayeeng wei embei teyoxe e xe xel betiyeing xoumeeng yuw eno ma, moxo la nanghei inyon me la en embei na teyoxe me na neil qayeeng eivek beyeeng wei Galili nei.
Gyeik Yoan ngo eivek xeitueing en vati wei Kilisi di wong o, moxo wong e xe xel betiyeing la,
bei teling e, “Beip inye wang on tiwei tyek nam o, o xa mendi daxe tambiy bange?”
Yesu neil elox, “Xam lox neil wou Yoan en vati wei xam ghe ngo me ghe wei yo:

Xel matekeing eno mend yeila, me xel wei vaxend nol eno di la, me xel wei wo vanei lepa eno wo nimzalek, me xel wei nenyend wo qatu eno ngo wou, me xel meyeing eno qandi lek, de Xoulek Nimza eno xel neil wou xel kanyoyeiw.
Mata e na wou xel wei xel xe wongeingis se tei en qayeeng wei ay yo.”
Ka Yoan xe xel betiyeing la veil, Yesu luk wou xel qendu yon en Yoan: “Xam ghe la tembuing bandaing nei bei na gwei vati? Ghet wei laweeng di vei elox me loum o?
Wangwei na ma nei, yon xam ghe la being na gwei vati? Moux ti wei vunek en teimb nimza yo? Ma, xel eti yeiw wei mi vunek en teimb nimza eno mindei eivek king beeng.
Woyom xam ghe la being na gwei vati? Poropet ti? Ee, a neil wou xam bei, Poropet tiyon ghanaw xel poropet ba veil.
Tambiy tine tiwei xel byex eivek xoulek eno nambei nye,

content.text: “ ‘Wei, tyek a bong a xe nenyalesana ti na mamunghexeing en wang,
tiwei tyek menyex wou sakwaing atax en wang o.’ Malakai 3:1

content: A neil wou xam zonghek: Yoan Lipekeing ghanaw xel wei tayeiw wou xel lek tembuing ne yo leind, ekom e tiwei lei maeing eivek tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu eno ghanaw e.

Eivek bouk wei Yoan Lipekeing neil xoulek me elam tyip gweimbeeng ne, eno xel wo vevek nikanzek en na qou tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu yo, de xel wo vevek nikanzek om inyon wo nimaying ngenong wou e.
En xel poropet dalus me petieing neil qayeeng poropet me e lam tyip wou bouk wei Yoan o.
Me wangwei wa laleim devind bei na qou vati wei a neil ne, ond e yon Eliya wei embei nam o.
Tambiy wei nenya nale lek e yo, ond e ngo qayeeng tine.
“Tyek a neil qayeeng lek vati bei talex moux alis vex wei gweimbeeng ne? Xel on ambei yakyak wei mindei eivek beyeeng vateivek me mi taxe la wou xel bamba:

content.text: me xa wong lalo wei lalei pyaweing o,

content: En Yoan lam eno se mi ya yaeing me num numeing, me xel neil, ‘Moxo memo ti toundei eivek e.’

Xomaxoneing Neu Moux lam ya yaeing me num numeing, me xel neil, ‘Wei, inye e wei mi zongaxei me num ngenong o. E yon gweleeng wei xel wei mi qou takis me sewokeing o.’ Ekom e xe lupeyei nimza yon talex bei e xe xuk on la bombek.”
Lalei pyaweing en xomaxoneing wei se pekwi xow o
Woyom Yesu neil beyeeng tiyon en ingwei mi wong lulvako eivek o, ekom xel on se pekwi xow.

“Xam Korasin me xam Betsaida ghe gwaleeng amim en tyek xam a tulek nimaying. Wangwei lulvako wei a wong eivek xam eno xel bong eivek Taia me Saidon, on beip xel pekwi xow takwei nei me byex teimb wei talot o de ev vewev me pelei lek xow.
Ekom a neil wou xam bei, lek bouk wei Anutu embei bong qayeeng en xomaxoneing dalus eno tyek nimaying ngandoung qandi wou xam ghanaw veil nambei ingwei qandi wou Taia me Saidon o.

De xam Kapenaom, tyek xel a zeim xam ghe zekna pu wei tyoung nei? Ma yo, tyek wa deteina beyeeng wei meyeing o. En wangwei lulvako wei a wong wou xam eno xel bong eivek Sodom, yond tyek Sodom na mi mendei me e nam atyip bouk tine is.
Ekom a neil wou xam bei lek bouk wei ngoeing qayeeng eno tyek bo nimaying ngandoung wou xam ghanaw Sodom.”
Xam ghe nam wou ay me na qou laweeng

Lek seivma tiyon Yesu neil, “Mang, a sanghoxe wang, Tambiy Ngandoung wei tyoung gheyapu me tembuing o, en nambei wang vun lulti beimambei ne veil xel wei lundpeyei me kwa nimza yo, dom ghe talex eyeip yaing wou xel yakyak.
Ee Mang, en inye wang betiwou wamaxow xe woueing nalei nimza.

“Lulul dalusateiv eno Mang toung eivek a memang. Xelti se yeimawou xomaxoneing Neu Moux qe Ma venaxow, me xelti se yeimawou Ma qe Neu Moux venaxow me eti yeiw wei Neu Moux beyal bei talex e wou xel o.
“Xam dalus wei ghe mi wong pok ngandoung me ghe mi qalei nimaying eno xam lam wou ay me tyek a bong xam ghe na mendei veil xuk wei xam ghe wong o.
Xam qalei a xe pelang maying lek xow me qou kwa wou ay, en a ne a laleing xeiles me laleing vevopeing, me tyek xam numim na mendei me na qou laweeng.
En a xe pelang on levismaeing me a xe maying ne vevopeing.”
